1.he: איזה דרך הרוח אשר הלך איזה חק ומשפט הכתוב לפנינו בתורה למצוא לו מקור במנהג העם
1.note: the syntax is loose; rendered as: by what path a law in the Torah can be traced back to a source in popular custom.

2.note: the second figure is unclear in the scan (ו or ז); read as 36b. The discussion of new grain is at Kiddushin 37b.

3.note: printed so (or ט"ז, unclear in the scan); the verse on planting near the altar is Deuteronomy 16:21.

4.note: printed so; the altar on Mount Ebal is commanded in Deuteronomy 27.

5.note: printed so; Gideon's altar is in Judges 6.

6.note: printed so; the ark at Beth-shemesh is 1 Samuel 6.

7.note: printed so; Samuel's sacrifice at Bethlehem is 1 Samuel 16.

8.note: printed so; the altar of earth is Exodus 20:21 (20:24 in English Bibles).

9.note: Print unclear (OCR מ"ט); read ט"ו, i.e. Judges 15:15, Samson and the jawbone.

10.note: Printed so; no such word; perhaps a misprint for מבצע ('from greed'), which the context suggests.

11.note: The verse is 1 Samuel 8:7; the print has ט'.

12.note: Saul's removal of the mediums and wizards is 1 Samuel 28:3; the print has כ"ג.

13.note: Printed so; read as Aramaic-style אתיות, 'coming [times]'; perhaps a misprint for בעתות.

14.note: Deuteronomy 16:9 is about counting weeks; the priests' teaching is at 17:9-11 (or 33:10). Kept as printed.

15.note: The verse is Jeremiah 8:8. Kept as printed.

16.note: Printed so (last figure looks like ה); the passage is Malachi 2:6-8.

17.note: The passage on Mesha's son is at Sanhedrin 39b; the print has ל"ט. (39a).

18.note: Print blurred at this point; read שארעו לנגד[ו], 'that happened before it'.

19.note: Print unclear (looks like מתח ההטא); read מונח החטא, 'there lies the sin'.

20.note: Print unclear (could be ככום); read כשום, 'when [they] were put'.

21.note: The passage is at Bava Batra 15a; the colon may be a separator, not the folio side. Kept as printed.

22.note: Initials printed ע. א.; taken as Karl Otfried Müller, author of Die Dorier.

23.note: Name printed unclearly (OCR מיני אום); the commentator is not identified.

24.note: Debir is in Judges 1:11; kept as printed.
